The '''Kriz sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Berrol's Donn/Legends|Berrol's Donn]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agent [[Fulkrehm Protial]] went undercover in various bars in the Kriz sector, in disguise as a drunken [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
